tasks.prompt: An invoices API caches a tenant-specific invoice summary by numeric invoice ID only. Two tenants can have the same numeric ID. Fix the cache so one tenant never receives another tenant's data, including after eviction and concurrent requests.
acceptance: Model tenant and authorization scope in the cache key and server-side retrieval
Prove two tenants with the same invoice ID remain isolated under alternating reads
Describe cache invalidation and stale entry handling after ownership or permission changes
negative_controls: A client-side visibility check without server cache separation is rejected
Returning a cached cross-tenant record with an HTTP 403 status is rejected

tasks.prompt: An AI development planner is given a task that explicitly says 'Do not modify the Android app; update the backend API only', while stale saved context says platform=android. Define how the planner should handle this contradiction without silently executing the Android workflow.
acceptance: Identify the conflict between explicit task and stale platform context
Reject or request revalidation of the contradiction rather than silently choosing Android
Propose two opposite-direction regression cases including a later explicit positive request
negative_controls: Ignoring the user's explicit exclusion is rejected
Replacing typed context secretly without recording the conflict is rejected

tasks.prompt: A team distributes skill instruction files in a ZIP and discovers a file can be altered after release without invalidating the structural check. Design a deterministic offline integrity check that catches byte changes but does not misrepresent an unsigned manifest as a digital signature.
acceptance: Specify a canonical covered-file list and SHA-256 digest comparison
Reject missing manifest records, unexpected records and changed files
Distinguish accidental corruption checks from authenticated publisher signatures
negative_controls: A checksum copied from the same untrusted attacker-controlled manifest is not proof of identity
Requiring paid network access or external AI inference for offline integrity is rejected

tasks.prompt: A Python skill installer promises preview by default. It imports a local router module during preview and quietly creates __pycache__ in the source package. Stop disk writes during preview, retain explicit apply-only copying and preserve existing user's skill directories.
acceptance: Prevent Python bytecode creation in source package during ordinary preview
Prove preview never creates a destination directory and apply is explicit
Reject overwriting existing skill directories even when source names collide
negative_controls: Only invoking python -B in the test runner is not sufficient to fix normal users
Fixing preview by deleting user data or existing directories is rejected
